fusions.name: Splitting Maul
fusions.desc: Sends a swipe that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then forks to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Drives 2 tines forward in a spread; each tine deals 10 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Cuts Both Ways
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Trailing Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a second blow forks to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
